comparison_identity.aggregation: equal cell means per tokenizer then maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base; the two marker strata are reported separately and both are load-bearing
comparison_identity.comparator: registered impact-recovered(<check>@<t>) / cause-resolved(<cause>, checked-by=<test>) marker form minus the shortest adequate careful-English claim carrying the SAME incident, check/time (or cause, post-change test); the careful rendering is template-regular and is published verbatim in the test set
comparison_identity.population: 32 fresh authored complete pairs: 16 impact-recovered and 16 cause-resolved, spread over six low-stakes domains (retail software, warehouse mechanical, plant mechanical, warehouse operations, freight logistics, document workflow, public event); authored, not sampled from natural prose
comparison_identity.unit_span: one complete incident-handoff claim naming its incident and either its impact check with observation time or its causal mechanism with post-change test

aggregation.rule: equal cell means per tokenizer then maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base; the two marker strata are reported separately and both are load-bearing

estimand_contract.contrast: registered impact-recovered(<check>@<t>) / cause-resolved(<cause>, checked-by=<test>) marker form minus the shortest adequate careful-English claim carrying the SAME incident, check/time (or cause, post-change test); the careful rendering is template-regular and is published verbatim in the test set
estimand_contract.population: 32 fresh authored complete pairs: 16 impact-recovered and 16 cause-resolved, spread over six low-stakes domains (retail software, warehouse mechanical, plant mechanical, warehouse operations, freight logistics, document workflow, public event); authored, not sampled from natural prose
estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete incident-handoff claim naming its incident and either its impact check with observation time or its causal mechanism with post-change test

method: Preserve the source complete-claim unit, comparator templates, tokenizer roster, equal ordered form weights, least-favourable maximum-mean reducer and member-span interval; replace every incident/check/time/cause/test input.
scope: Current tokenizer cost only; not comprehension, physical recovery, causal attribution, robustness or adoption.
selection: Thirty-two wholly fresh complete claims: sixteen new incident worlds rendered once for each required form, with the source's exact seven served domain labels and 3/1/1/2/3/3/3 distribution.
